title: 33 research-backed UI/UX implementation ideas
purpose: Implementation map with verified completed refinements and separately gated proposals; not approval of remaining ideas.
method: Reviewed current code/design records and fresh primary guidance. No fresh competitor feature verification, participant study, production measurement or accessibility certification.
already_implemented: Local reader/admin accounts and browser emulations

gates.R: Existing-intent refinement candidate; still trace to the current specification before implementation.
gates.C: Interface/data/auth contract review and documented tests required before implementation.
gates.H: Human product/privacy/spec approval required; proposed spec 004 tasks remain blocked by T000.

effort.L: New data contracts, architecture or substantial workflow

priority_note: Relative judgment, not measured ROI. Validate against task-based research.

scent.principle: Labels and surrounding cues should help readers predict destination value.

filters.principle: Filtering should preserve continuity; interaction design depends on intent and response time.

disclosure.principle: Defer specialized controls while keeping primary tasks available.

details.principle: Disclose secondary information; do not hide information most users need.

errors.principle: Pair an error summary with field errors and links to the relevant inputs.

check.principle: Let people verify and edit consequential structured submissions before committing them.

status.principle: Announce action results without moving focus unnecessarily.

auth.principle: Support password managers and paste; avoid unaided cognitive authentication tests.

reflow.principle: Retain information and functionality at equivalent 320 CSS pixel width; test zoom as well as width.

focus.principle: Sticky UI must not completely obscure keyboard focus.

motion.principle: Allow nonessential interaction animation to be disabled.

charts.principle: Keep chart encoding simple and focus each chart on one message.

vitals.principle: Evaluate loading, responsiveness and stability; distinguish lab measurements from field data.

inspiration.principle: Reference composition and navigation selectively; do not equate visual novelty with usability.

ideas.title: Direct guest navigation
ideas.implementation: Show Feed and About directly when the guest navigation has only two destinations; keep the larger signed-in workspace disclosure.
ideas.acceptance: Guest destinations remain visible at 320px without overlap; keyboard order remains logical.

ideas.title: Optional reading density
ideas.implementation: Offer compact and comfortable spacing with a browser-local preference; preserve readable line lengths and touch targets.
ideas.acceptance: Both densities pass narrow-width, large-text and keyboard checks; preference storage failure falls back safely.

ideas.title: Compact local-demo controls
ideas.implementation: Allow the test-role instructions to collapse after selection while retaining a persistent local/synthetic-data label and role entry points.
ideas.acceptance: The local environment remains unmistakable; test-role controls remain discoverable; normal server has no demo UI.

ideas.title: Consistent page landmarks
ideas.implementation: Normalize primary headings, landmarks and skip destinations across reader and module pages.
ideas.acceptance: One useful primary heading and working skip target per screen; focus is visible below the sticky header.

ideas.title: Exact dates on demand
ideas.implementation: Keep relative age for scanning, with an accessible exact publication timestamp and timezone on demand; distinguish first seen from published.
ideas.acceptance: Keyboard and touch can reveal the date; missing publication time is explicitly labeled first seen.

ideas.title: Explain each sort order
ideas.implementation: Explain Newest, Top, Most voted and Significance next to the sort control, including the time window.
ideas.acceptance: Readers can identify which sort is time-, vote- or signal-driven without hover; no ranking rule changes.

ideas.title: Honest facet counts
ideas.implementation: Show contextual counts beside source/topic choices, computed under the same admission and filter rules as the feed.
ideas.acceptance: Counts exclude hidden/off-topic rows and private account state; count semantics and performance are tested.

ideas.title: Keep the selected topic visible
ideas.implementation: Scroll the active topic into the horizontal strip when navigation changes, without shifting page focus.
ideas.acceptance: A selected offscreen topic becomes visible on phones; reduced motion and keyboard position are preserved.

ideas.title: Safe search-match highlighting
ideas.implementation: Mark query matches in titles and summaries with text nodes and mark elements rather than interpolated HTML.
ideas.acceptance: Matches explain relevance; malicious query text renders literally; source titles and URLs remain intact.

ideas.title: Search scope and useful examples
ideas.implementation: Explain that current search covers stored titles and summaries; offer a few curated query examples without suggesting unsupported syntax or full text.
ideas.acceptance: Example queries produce expected synthetic hits; no unsupported semantic-search claim.

ideas.title: Preserve filters when changing topic
ideas.implementation: Make topic changes alter the topic only, preserving query, source kind and time; retain a separate Reset filters action.
ideas.acceptance: Topic switching retains other criteria and URL/Back behavior; restoring an empty result is clear.

ideas.title: Saved searches
ideas.implementation: Let readers name and reopen filter combinations; decide browser-local versus account synchronization before adding storage.
ideas.acceptance: A saved query restores the same filter semantics; readers can rename/delete it; storage/privacy decision is approved.

ideas.title: Source-role legend
ideas.implementation: Agree primary/secondary, preprint/reviewed and vendor/independent labels with reasons; show unknown rather than inferring credibility.
ideas.acceptance: Approved labels describe sources, never people; missing labels stay unknown; no automatic score-weight change.

ideas.title: Compare source coverage
ideas.implementation: Extend Covered by into a compact comparison of source role, first-seen time and coverage lag; do not equate domain count with independent evidence.
ideas.acceptance: Every comparison field has provenance; time semantics are explicit; unavailable fields remain unavailable.

ideas.title: Comparable benchmark charts
ideas.implementation: Compare reported results only when benchmark version, metric, unit and evaluation setting align; otherwise show a table marked not comparable.
ideas.acceptance: No incompatible scores share an axis; chart has textual values, source links and unknown-state handling.

ideas.title: Claim-to-evidence map
ideas.implementation: Map specific claims to supporting, challenging or unverified evidence, retaining source excerpts/links within content policy and human review.
ideas.acceptance: No unsupported truth/confidence score; every edge is attributed; unknown and disputed states remain visible.

ideas.title: Score provenance and rule version
ideas.implementation: Show the rule version and scoring timestamp separately from publication time; link to an approved change history.
ideas.acceptance: Current explanation is reproducible from the recorded version; old values are not invented or silently recomputed as historical facts.

ideas.title: Copy a verified citation
ideas.implementation: Copy title, known author, actual date and canonical URL; include DOI only when verified and never fabricate missing bibliographic data.
ideas.acceptance: Plain-text citation matches stored evidence; missing fields are omitted or explicit; copy success/failure is announced.

ideas.title: First-class saved-story destination
ideas.implementation: Expose Saved as a signed-in navigation destination, using the existing saved filter and per-user authorization.
ideas.acceptance: One clear route to saved stories on desktop/phone; guest action returns through sign-in without exposing another account.

ideas.title: Batch organization
ideas.implementation: Select a bounded set of stories for adding to a list; explicitly define filtered-page versus all-results selection.
ideas.acceptance: Selection count and scope are visible; partial failures are attributable and retryable; no global hidden selection.

ideas.title: Reliable undo for saved actions
ideas.implementation: Offer Undo after saving/removing, backed by explicit desired-state operations rather than blindly toggling again.
ideas.acceptance: Rapid clicks, retries and concurrent tabs cannot invert the wrong state; status and focus remain useful.

ideas.title: Opt-in reading history
ideas.implementation: Provide Continue reading with a documented retention period, opt-in and clear/delete controls; avoid background tracking by default.
ideas.acceptance: Scope, retention and deletion are approved; shared-device logout removes any local account data.

ideas.title: What changed since the last visit
ideas.implementation: Separate genuinely new stories from updated coverage using real timestamps and approved last-visit semantics.
ideas.acceptance: No change history is fabricated from current rows; reader can reset the marker; update and publication times stay distinct.

ideas.title: A real account-recovery path
ideas.implementation: Agree a secure owner-assisted or credential-recovery workflow compatible with the username/password-only agreement before implementing it.
ideas.acceptance: Recovery cannot enumerate or take over accounts; no email collection or security-policy change without partner approval.

ideas.title: Password-manager compatibility tests
ideas.implementation: Extend current autocomplete/paste support with cross-browser and real password-manager testing; retain generic credential errors.
ideas.acceptance: Pasting and autofill work in sign-in/signup; visibility control does not erase entries or break submission.

ideas.title: Field-linked validation summaries
ideas.implementation: For multi-field forms, focus a concise error summary with links to inline field errors while preserving safe input.
ideas.acceptance: Errors are associated with fields; links focus the correct input; password values are not logged or echoed in messages.

ideas.title: Recover unsent drafts safely
ideas.implementation: Offer explicit draft recovery for notes/submissions with account-scoped storage, retention and logout behavior.
ideas.acceptance: Another account or guest cannot recover private drafts; storage-disabled mode works; logout/deletion behavior is approved.

ideas.title: Session-expiry continuation
ideas.implementation: On expired-session writes, preserve the intended destination and offer reauthentication; require explicit resubmission of actions.
ideas.acceptance: No automatic replay of votes, notes or admin actions; users can retry without losing context or leaking private content.

ideas.title: Zoom and assistive-technology matrix
ideas.implementation: Add 200%/400% zoom, text spacing, contrast checks, keyboard-only flows and manual screen-reader checks beyond screenshot widths.
ideas.acceptance: Controls remain usable at equivalent 320 CSS pixels; focus stays visible; automated checks are not called full compliance.

ideas.title: Consistent motion language
ideas.implementation: Inventory transitions across modules; use short state-relevant motion only, honor reduced motion everywhere and never imply success before confirmation.
ideas.acceptance: Reduced-motion checks cover all modules; loading/error/success remain understandable with animation disabled.

ideas.title: Performance budgets with evidence
ideas.implementation: Capture reproducible lab baselines for feed/filter/evidence interactions and set bundle/DOM/request budgets; distinguish them from production field data.
ideas.acceptance: Track LCP, INP and CLS with appropriate tooling; target good p75 field thresholds only when actual field data exists; no fabricated production measurements.

ideas.title: Scale server-side result retrieval
ideas.implementation: Profile the current gather/sort/slice path before moving eligible filtering/order/pagination into indexed SQL; keep guest and personalized responses cache-isolated.
ideas.acceptance: SQLite/Postgres result parity, hidden/off-topic exclusion and user privacy survive changes; actual query costs and response size are measured.

ideas.title: Task-based usability benchmark
ideas.implementation: Use fixed tasks: find a relevant story, explain a score, recover no results, return from page two, save as reader and inspect admin boundaries; then run consented human sessions.
ideas.acceptance: Record task success, errors, time and comprehension against a baseline; keep synthetic automation separate from human usability evidence.
